test_index_union_same_types: test the Index.union method returns the same dtype when unioning two identical sorted indexes
test_index_union_different_types: test the Index.union method computes the correct common dtype when unioning two indexes of different dtypes
test_index_intersection_duplicates: test the Index.intersection method handles duplicate values and returns unique intersection elements
test_index_union_dtypes: test the Index.union method produces the expected dtype for various dtype combinations including datetime and period
test_index_set_operations_errors: test that Index intersection, union, difference, and symmetric_difference raise TypeError on non-iterable input
